Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
Vakalatnama filed by Shri Arun Kumar Pandey, Advocate on behalf of the complainant is taken on
record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the complainant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P. and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 57 of 2020 under Sections 406/420/506 I.P.C., Police Station Gazipur, District Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent person and he is in jail since 19.01.2023.

He further submitted that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case due Mohd. Azam Hasmati @ Maulana Azam Hasmti vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39322452/

sentences.text: He further submitted that during the pendency of trial, the issue has been resolved out of Court and the alleged amount of Rs.7,00,000/- (Seven lakh rupees) has been refunded to the complainant of the present case by the deponent.
He further submitted that the complainant has no grudge against the applicant and he does not want to prosecute him.
He further submitted that the applicant no. 1 is having criminal antecedent of one case, which is pending.
He further submitted that the charge sheet has already been filed and trial of the present case is not going on.
In these circumstances, the applicant is entitled for bail.

In case of being enlarged on bail,
he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the applicant for grant of bail and submitted that after detailed investigation, charge-sheet was submitted, therefore, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

However, learned counsel for the complainant does not dispute this fact that the alleged amount of Rs.7,00,000/- (Seven lakh rupees) has already been refunded to the complainant by the deponent and the complainant has no claim, and in case, the applicant is released on bail, he has no objection to the same.

Considering the rival submissions of learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the complainant and going through the contents of the F.I.R., bail application as well as other relevant documents, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

Let applicant - Mohd. Azam Hasmati @ Maulana Azam Hasmti - be released on bail in Case Crime No. 57 of 2020 under Sections 406/420/506 I.P.C., Police Station Gazipur, District Lucknow, on his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(1) The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.
(2) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office or tamper with the evidence.
(3) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in Court.
